subject.title: docs: honor resolved Crabbox provider configuration

question: Should normal ClawSweeper validation honor an operator-resolved `local-container` provider, or should remote proof remain explicitly constrained to the repository’s approved remote provider lanes?
rationale: The PR changes operational guidance that determines where validation runs, while the current snapshot directs an AWS default and the shared-skill source-of-truth must be updated outside this repository.

options.title: Define the policy upstream and sync it
options.body: Update the canonical `openclaw/agent-skills` Crabbox guidance with an explicit distinction between resolved configuration and required remote-proof lanes, then synchronize this snapshot.

options.title: Retain the current remote-default guidance
options.body: Keep the current snapshot unchanged until a canonical policy confirms that local-container is acceptable for the affected ClawSweeper validation paths.

recommendation.title: Define the policy upstream and sync it
recommendation.body: Update the canonical `openclaw/agent-skills` Crabbox guidance with an explicit distinction between resolved configuration and required remote-proof lanes, then synchronize this snapshot.
